notationPrinciple.literalGerman: Ebenso sind die doppelten Notenreihen auf einem Liniensystem nur als zwei verschiedene Weisen zu betrachten, wenn sie nicht mit „Chor“ bezeichnet sind.
notationPrinciple.english: Two note lines on a single staff are to be treated as two different melodies unless marked Chor.
notationPrinciple.application: Preserve coherent upper/lower alternatives in the third printed setting; common heads reconverge, and no alternatives are sounded as chords. Independent musical review remains pending.

figures.name: T’lischo k’ta-noh
figures.contextPending: Two adjacent equal C4 dotted quarters are linked by the printed arc across the bar; retain both written components with a held pitch, not a fabricated new attack.

figures.name: Aslo → ge-resch
figures.contextPending: Both two-beam groups contain the same four sixteenths C5/B-natural4/D5/C5; the last quarter heads C5/A4 are the alternatives. No third beam or tuplet numeral is present.

figures.name: Gerschajim
figures.contextPending: The rapid group starts with one eighth, followed by two sixteenths in each line. The natural belongs only to upper B4; the lower notes are G4/F4. Two quarter rests and an eighth rest after the final quarter are retained.

figures.name: Dargo → t’wir
figures.contextPending: Only the pickup, middle two heads of the second four-sixteenth group and final quarter have separate pitches. Preserve the written sixteenth rest/E4 sixteenth before the barline, upper E-flat and explicit common E-natural, and final eighth rest. The first descending B is B-flat from the key after a barline.
